name: Eversource (Massachusetts) - NSTAR Electric (incl. former Western Massachusetts Electric)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public eversource.com pages (read in a browser, Boston MA location; no sign-in). Sign-in heading 'Residential/Business Sign In' with 'Email or Username' and Password; the privacy policy says the registration email is the User ID. Guest Pay uses Speedpay for credit cards with no sign-in. Massachusetts residential card payments are fee-free (Electronic Payment Recovery tariff: the fee-free card option is for residential customers, costs recovered in rates), so card and guest fees are $0 (reviewer read the tariff PDF on 2026-10-10: M.D.P.U. No. 76D, effective January 1, 2025, recovers the costs of the Fee Free Credit and Debit Card Payment Option, available to residential customers only). Auto Pay is bank-only; the customer picks how many days before the due date it draws (the format has a fixed leadDays only, so the family default is kept); if a payment posts before the auto-pay date only the remaining balance is drafted; a pending payment cannot be edited. Past Bills and Payments shows 36 months. Budget Billing and payment plans exist; the contact page shows phone numbers only after a town is chosen, so the catalog phone (800-592-2000) is kept. The Connecticut Eversource record is the same site and gets no dossier. The catalog mail address carries a research remark, so the contact-us article is overridden and points to the address on the bill stub (the site shows mail addresses only after a town is chosen).

guest_pay.note: Guest Pay takes credit cards through Speedpay; no sign-in needed.

autopay.note: Auto Pay draws from a bank account only. Once a payment is pending it cannot be edited; cancel it and make a one-time payment instead.

help.title: Other ways to pay
paragraphs: Sign in to view or pay your bill. Guest Pay uses the Speedpay credit card system, so you do not need to sign in to an Eversource account. In Massachusetts, residential customers can pay by credit or debit card without a fee.

You can also pay in the Eversource mobile app, by text, in person, by phone or by mail, and you can make a one-time gift payment on someone else's account. If you pay in person a day or two before a scheduled shut-off, call Eversource so service is not interrupted.
steps: Pick a bank account or card.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay deducts your electric or gas bill from your bank account each month; it is not available by credit card.

You choose how many days before the due date the withdrawal happens. If you pay something before the auto-pay date, only the remaining balance is drafted. Update your settings anytime from Account Settings.
Once a payment is pending it cannot be edited. To change the amount, cancel the scheduled auto pay and make a one-time payment.
steps: Open Auto Pay in Account Settings.
Choose your bank account and how many days before the due date to pay.

help.title: Payment Plans and Assistance
paragraphs: If you have a past-due balance, a payment plan can help prevent a shut-off and is open to most customers.
Budget Billing sets a fixed monthly amount and settles up at the end of the year. Income-based programs, such as the Massachusetts discount rate, are available to customers who qualify.

help.title: View your bill
paragraphs: Sign in to view and pay your current bill. Usage Details lets you compare your energy use and costs from month to month.

help.title: Past Bills and Payments
paragraphs: Past Bills and Payments shows your bills and payments for up to 36 months, and you can view and pay your current bill there too.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: With Paperless Billing your bill no longer comes in the mail; you are notified by email or text when your bill is ready and when payment is due.

help.title: Start, stop or transfer service
paragraphs: Use Moving: Start, Stop or Transfer Service to stop service at your current address on the date you choose.

help.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs: The email address you registered with is your User ID when you sign in.
Budget Billing evens out seasonal spikes with a fixed monthly amount.

help.title: Contact us
paragraphs: To pay by mail, use the payment address printed on your bill stub; Pay Offline also lists in-person payment locations by town. Allow 2 business days for in-person payments to post, and if you pay in person a day or two before a scheduled shut-off, call us so service is not interrupted.

extra.intent: Can you use a credit card for Eversource Auto Pay? Find the answer without enrolling or changing any settings.

solution.text: No. Auto Pay is not available by credit card; it draws from a bank account.

extra.intent: How many months of past payments can an Eversource customer see online? Do not make a payment or change any settings.
